about: Natural Earth 1:50m vector layers (public domain; made with Natural Earth, naturalearthdata.com). The extract keeps no names and rounds to 2 decimals.

borders_1914.about: 1914 Western/Central Europe sovereign land borders (Germany incl. Alsace-Lorraine & Eupen-Malmedy, France, Belgium, Netherlands, Luxembourg, Switzerland, UK, Austria-Hungary, Italy, Denmark; pre-1919 Treaty of Frankfurt / Vienna / Congress of Vienna lines).
borders_1914.citation: Schvitz, Guy, Seraina Rueegger, Luc Girardin, Lars-Erik Cederman, Nils Weidmann, and Kristian Skrede Gleditsch (2022). Mapping The International System, 1886-2017: The CShapes 2.0 Dataset. Journal of Conflict Resolution 66(1): 144-161; Ourednik, A. (2021). historical-basemaps world_1914.geojson.
